scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Cottage Industries: Financial Assistance To Cottage Industries
other_conditions: Applicant must be associated with a Cottage Industry
Applicant must have passed at least Standard Four (IV)

Applicant must have undergone a minimum of one month of training from a Government of India recognised institute in the area of the proposed business, or have at least one year of experience in the same activity, or be a hereditary craftsperson
Additional capital subsidy of 10% is available for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Women, and differently‑abled persons with 30% or more disability
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% capital subsidy (maximum ₹5,00,000) and 50% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹20,00,000, with an extra 10% capital subsidy for SC/ST/Women/differently‑abled beneficiaries.
